ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) to low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration profile along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a slightly concave trailing edge profile with a distinct posterior sweep toward the tips.
